# Whistle Stop Grill & Bar

> Whistle Stop Grill & Bar is a locally owned restaurant, bar, and live music patio at 915 Main Street in downtown Safety Harbor, Florida. Open since 1995 (4.4 stars across 2,000+ Google reviews), it serves scratch American bar-and-grill favorites, fresh Gulf grouper, burgers, fried green tomatoes, cocktails, 18 craft & domestic taps, live local music, and dog-friendly open-air dining.

Use the linked public pages as the authoritative source for current website information. Event performers, dates, menu items, prices, hours, ordering availability, and promotions can change; verify those details on the relevant page before presenting them as current.
